treatment: Copy only immutable pre-window prediction parameters, omitting fitting covariance matrices that prediction never reads. Prior 97-window replay must match the actual final model digest exactly.
primaryMeasures: prediction support and measured goal result
archive continuity and exact frame binding
limitation: One paired development comparison, ordered control then candidate. It does not estimate a general speedup, knowledge-retention benefit or multistage capability. All refusals and failures are retained.
